start_date.description: The starting date of the statistics to retrieve. Must follow format YYYY-MM-DD

end_date.description: The end date of the statistics to retrieve. Defaults to today. Must follow format YYYY-MM-DD.

categories.description: The individual categories that you want to retrieve statistics for. You may include up to 10 different categories.

limit.description: The number of results to include.

offset.description: The number of results to skip.

aggregated_by.description: How to group the statistics. Must be either "day", "week", or "month".
